origin.description: Pack a time and a status into a survival response. Two arguments are right censored. interval2 infers the interval code.
origin.details: Pack a time and a status into a survival response. Two arguments are right censored. interval2 infers the interval code.
origin.value: A Surv response with time and status columns.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
value <- (function() {
  a <- as.character(Surv(c(1, 2.5, 10, NA), c(1, 0, 1, 1)))
  b <- as.character(Surv(c(0, 1), c(5, 6.25), c(1, 0), type = "counting"))
  d <- as.character(Surv(c(1, 2), c(1, 3), type = "interval2"))
  e <- as.character(Surv(c(1, 2), c(0, 1), type = "left"))
  c(paste(a, collapse = "|"), paste(b, collapse = "|"), paste(d, collapse = "|"), paste(e, collapse = "|"))
})()
cat(paste(value, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Pack a time and a status into a survival response. Two arguments are right censored. interval2 infers the interval code.
translation.details: Pack a time and a status into a survival response. Two arguments are right censored. interval2 infers the interval code.
translation.value: A Surv response with time and status columns.
translation.example:
from survival import Surv

def one():
    a = Surv([1, 2.5, 10, float("nan")], [1, 0, 1, 1]).character()
    b = Surv([0, 1], [5, 6.25], [1, 0], type="counting").character()
    d = Surv([1, 2], [1, 3], type="interval2").character()
    e = Surv([1, 2], [0, 1], type="left").character()
    return ["|".join(a), "|".join(b), "|".join(d), "|".join(e)]

print("\n".join(one()))
